messages:
olivia: Tiny alert with big vibes — we just passed 3.75M monthly requests 🎉
max: absolutely wild, huge congrats team :tada:
kim: rooftop micro-parade? hats, a tiny kite toss and the gong? :kite:
noah: i'll grab savory hand-pies (4 boxes). anyone need GF or vegan, reply GF / V
olivia: noted: ryan=GF, kim=V
ryan: GF here. also can someone bring the bamboo gong? it sounded amazing at launch day.
aria: i'll Zoom in from Berlin — can we do a 15-min rally, i have a sync at 12:30 CET :wave:
procurement-bot: Snack order submitted (order #78912) — ETA 12:05 local.
max: merch thought: tiny kite pins for badges. low-cost and very meme-able.
kim: posted a sticker mockup in #design, can tag you there max.
noah: yes to redwood pixel on the pin. very cute.
olivia: quick blurb for release notes/docs: "Redwood Inference reaches 3.75M monthly requests; caching and routing improvements reduced token spend and improved p95 latency." short and shareable?
aria: perfect. shoutout infra + serving teams for tuning the cache — massive ops win.
ryan: infra + serving + docs teamwork = chef's kiss :clap:
max: plan: kite-pin mini parade at 11:45, gong at 12:00 PST, pies after. RSVP here or react.
olivia: GIF https://giphy.com/gifs/celebrate-team-small — rooftop if you're local.
noah: bringing an extra kite and a kazoo.
procurement-bot: Friendly reminder: return shared kites to the supply closet Rm B4 after use.
olivia: thanks everyone. quick, loud, joyful — see you soon!
